tasks.title: Promote the four staged identity migrations into the live Flyway tree
tasks.dod: The four staged pairs are promoted to db/migration V…__*.sql + db/rollback U…__*.sql, and MigrationRollbackIT applies up → down → up for all of them on Testcontainers pgvector.

tasks.title: Add identity domain primitives: typed ids, Clock, email canonicalisation, secrets, device naming and the public URL
tasks.dod: Unit tests pass for email validation + canonicalisation (AC-34, AC-83 examples), token/code generation and SHA-256 hashing, the User-Agent → label + device type mapper, and PublicUrl's origin/host/secure derivation.

tasks.title: Create the mail integration module with the Mailer port and the SMTP adapter
tasks.dod: telex.mail exists as an integration module depending on shared only, identity's allowedDependencies include mail, SmtpMailer sends via spring-boot-starter-mail (unit-tested against a mocked JavaMailSender), a RecordingMailer test double is available to integration tests, and ModularityTest is green.

tasks.title: Build the Owner and Sign-in Session core: start, resolve with the 30/90-day rules, end by key, and the SignInSessionStarted event
tasks.dod: Integration tests with a fixed Clock prove: start ends the browser's held session (AC-104), stores only the key hash and publishes SignInSessionStarted; resolve returns ended after 30 idle days (background requests ignored) or 90 days from start (AC-96), bumps activity at most once a minute; endByKey is idempotent; Owner find-or-create resolves concurrent inserts.

tasks.title: Issue a Sign-in Grant with its email and read a Sign-in Link without redeeming it
tasks.dod: Integration tests prove: an incomplete address sends nothing; a request supersedes every live grant for the canonical address, stores only hashes and sends one email (to the address as typed) holding the link and code; a mail failure rolls everything back; preview is read-only and refuses expired, superseded, used and void grants with the right reason.

tasks.title: Redeem a Sign-in Link or Sign-in Code atomically and start the Sign-in Session
tasks.dod: Integration tests with a fixed Clock prove: one conditional UPDATE redeems a grant at most once (two concurrent redeems, one winner); refusals classify as expired / used / void; wrong codes count atomically and the 5th voids code and link; a correct code kills the link; a new canonical address creates exactly one Owner; the browser's held session is replaced.

tasks.title: Send the "New sign-in to teleX" email from the SignInSessionStarted event after commit
tasks.dod: An @ApplicationModuleTest scenario proves: a non-creating SignInSessionStarted sends one "New sign-in to teleX" email to owner.email with browser, device type, local time with zone name, UTC and the sessions link; a creating one completes without email; a Mailer failure leaves the publication incomplete.

tasks.title: Add the Spring Security filter chain with the session cookie, CSRF and no-store, and switch problem codes to kebab-case
tasks.dod: Integration tests prove: a protected request with no or unknown cookie answers 401 unauthenticated, an ended/expired session 401 session-ended; a live one reaches the handler with the Owner in the security context and bumps activity unless X-Telex-Background: 1; public routes stay open; POST without X-XSRF-TOKEN answers 403 forbidden; every response carries Cache-Control: no-store; problem codes are kebab-case.

tasks.title: Expose the sign-in REST endpoints: request email, preview and redeem link, redeem code, sign out
tasks.dod: MockMvc integration tests (with CSRF) prove each of the five operations returns the contract's status, body and problem codes: 201 grant id, 200 preview, 200 SignedIn with the telex_session cookie, 410 refusals with email, 422 attemptsLeft, 400 email-incomplete / code-format, 503 mail-unavailable, and an idempotent 204 sign-out that clears the cookie.

tasks.title: List and end my Sign-in Sessions and answer "who am I", Owner-scoped end to end
tasks.dod: Integration tests prove: GET /api/v1/me returns ownerId, email as created and linkedAccountCount 0; GET /api/v1/sessions lists only the caller's live sessions with the current one flagged; DELETE ends only the caller's session (404 not-found for another Owner's, an ended or a missing one) and that browser's next request gets 401 session-ended; POST end-others leaves only the current session.

tasks.title: Wire Spring Security WebAuthn for passkey registration and passkey sign-in into the one session mechanism
tasks.dod: Integration tests with a WebAuthn test authenticator (webauthn4j test utilities or recorded ceremony data) prove: registration stores a credential under the Owner's user entity (name = OwnerId) with a server-side User-Agent label, created set and last_used null, and survives a save/reload on timestamptz; a verified assertion starts a Sign-in Session through SignInSessions.start (createdAccount false), sets telex_session and updates last_used; an unknown or removed credential answers 401 passkey-rejected; a bad attestation answers 400 passkey-registration-failed.

tasks.title: List and remove my Passkeys, filtered by my WebAuthn user entity
tasks.dod: Integration tests prove: GET /api/v1/passkeys lists only the caller's passkeys newest first with label, createdAt and lastUsedAt (null until first use) and an empty list when none; DELETE removes the caller's passkey including the last one and leaves open sessions alone; another Owner's or a missing id answers 404 not-found and changes nothing.

tasks.title: Set up the SPA router, query client and fetch client with failure routing, and build the system pages SCR-91, SCR-92 and SCR-93
tasks.dod: Vitest tests prove: the fetch client aborts after 10 s and routes 5xx/403/timeout to SCR-93 whose Retry repeats the request, 401 unauthenticated to SCR-01 remembering a single-slash path, 401 session-ended to SCR-92 with the query cache cleared, background refetches carry X-Telex-Background: 1 and every POST/DELETE carries X-XSRF-TOKEN; an unknown route renders SCR-91; SCR-91/92/93 render every state from screens.md; tsc, ESLint, Prettier clean.

tasks.title: Build Sign in (SCR-01, email part) and Check your email (SCR-07) with the Sign-in Code
tasks.dod: Vitest tests (mocked fetch) prove SCR-01 default/validation/submitting states and SCR-07 default/validation/submitting/wrong-code/refused-expired/refused-used/refused-void/resending/resent/no-grant states from screens.md, including that an incomplete address sends no request and a 400 code-format doesn't show tries left.

tasks.title: Build Confirm sign-in link (SCR-08) and the landing-after-sign-in rule
tasks.dod: Vitest tests prove SCR-08 loading/default/submitting/refused-*/link-unusable/resending states, that nothing is redeemed until "Continue as" is clicked, and that landing sends createdAccount to SCR-09 (never a remembered page), and otherwise to a remembered single-slash path or SCR-10.

tasks.title: Build Create a passkey (SCR-09) and "Sign in with a passkey" on SCR-01
tasks.dod: Vitest tests (mocked navigator.credentials and fetch) prove SCR-09 default/unsupported/waiting/failed/no-flag/success states and SCR-01 passkey-waiting/passkey-failed plus the silent return on a cancelled check; a shared webauthn helper converts Spring's JSON options to and from the browser API.

tasks.title: Build the signed-in PageFrame with Sign out and the empty Inbox (SCR-10)
tasks.dod: Vitest tests prove SCR-10 loading/default/note/error states with "Connect Telegram" while linkedAccountCount is 0, and that Sign out posts /api/v1/sign-out, clears the TanStack cache and lands on SCR-01, while a failed sign-out lands on SCR-93 with the session kept.

tasks.title: Build Profile and security (SCR-64): passkeys card and sign-in sessions card
tasks.dod: Vitest tests prove every SCR-64 state from screens.md: passkeys loading/list/empty/unsupported/adding/add-cancelled/add-failed/added/remove-confirm/removing/removed (incl. 404) and sessions loading/list/only-this/ending/ended (incl. 404)/ending-others, with the two cards loading and failing independently and the #sessions anchor scrolled into view.

tasks.title: Make teleX start with one command: Dockerfile, compose with app and Mailpit, README and a smoke script
tasks.dod: On a machine with only Docker, `docker compose up` builds and starts app + postgres + mailpit, the app waits for Postgres health and migrates, http://localhost:8080 shows SCR-01 and http://localhost:8025 shows the local mailbox; scripts/smoke.sh polls the sign-in page, requests a sign-in email and finds it through Mailpit's API; the README names both addresses, the one command, the production settings and the public-exposure warning.

tasks.title: Add Playwright end-to-end tests at 360 px and 1280 px with an accessibility scan and a virtual authenticator
tasks.dod: A Playwright suite runs against the compose stack at 360 px and 1280 px and passes: sign-up by link and by code (reading emails via Mailpit), passkey creation and passkey sign-in with a Chromium virtual authenticator, ending another session, sign out + Back, a remembered destination, SCR-91 and SCR-93 (by an intercepted 503); an axe scan of every screen of this feature reports 0 violations; CI runs it.

tasks.title: Reject addresses the mail library can't parse and roll back the grant on any send failure
tasks.dod: Unit test: EmailAddress.parse refuses `a,b@c.de` and `x(y@z.co` (400 email-incomplete/validation-failed). SmtpMailer maps jakarta.mail.MessagingException to MailUnavailable. Integration test: a send that throws a checked MessagingException stores no grant and does not supersede the earlier live grant; the API answers 503 per openapi, never 500.

tasks.title: Serialise Sign-in Grant issue per canonical address so at most one grant is live
tasks.dod: Integration test: N parallel requests for one address leave exactly one live grant (the others superseded); implemented with pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext(canonical)) before supersedeLive.

tasks.title: Harden passkey registration: long emails, concurrent user-entity insert, honest 5xx, one transaction
tasks.dod: Tests prove: an Owner with a 254-char email gets registration options (display_name fits — widen the unreleased migration column to 254 and update data-model.md, or truncate); two concurrent ensureUserEntity calls both succeed; a non-verification failure (e.g. DB down) surfaces as 5xx `unavailable`, only verification failures map to 400 passkey-registration-failed; a registered passkey is stored once with last_used NULL in one transaction. TestCredentialRecords moves out of org.springframework.* into a telex test package and stops using reflection.

tasks.title: Make framework errors use contract problem codes and validate API bodies against openapi.yaml
tasks.dod: Malformed/empty JSON on the sign-in POSTs answers 400 validation-failed; every emitted `code` is in the openapi ErrorCode enum. The shared *ApiIT request helpers validate success and problem bodies against contracts/openapi.yaml (e.g. swagger-request-validator / openapi4j), so drift fails a test.

tasks.title: Prove passkey sign-in end to end: removed passkey refused, success ends the held session and sends the notice
tasks.dod: Integration tests: after removing a real passkey its assertion is refused and no session starts; a successful passkey sign-in ends the session the browser held, starts a session of the same kind and records a 'New sign-in to teleX' notice; NewSignInNoticeIT also covers the code path; the failed-send test waits on a recorded attempt (latch/counter) instead of sleep.

tasks.title: Prove session lifetime over HTTP and that raw secrets never reach logs or the event registry
tasks.dod: HTTP integration tests: an X-Telex-Background: 1 request leaves last_activity_at unchanged while an unmarked one moves it; a cookie idle 30+ days or older than 90 days gets 401 session-ended. One test runs request → redeem → sign-out with output capture and asserts the raw token, code and cookie appear in neither logs nor event_publication.serialized_event.

tasks.title: Keep page actions correct across the Unavailable page: Retry carries its result, SCR-08 shows unusable, bare layout
tasks.dod: Vitest: 503 on Send → Retry lands on SCR-07 with the new grant; 503 on 'Send a new link' → Retry → a code redeems against the new grant; a repeat failure shows 'Still no answer.' and keeps SCR-93; confirm-time 410 without email or 400 shows SCR-08 link-unusable; SCR-93 renders inside the bare system layout; ConfirmLinkPage no longer routes failures during render.

tasks.title: Mark /me refetches as background and cover the untested SCR-64 and SCR-07 states
tasks.dod: Vitest: useMe refetches carry X-Telex-Background: 1; SCR-64 passkeys-unsupported, adding, add-cancelled, add-failed toast, added ('Never used'), removing, removed-on-404 and the #sessions anchor are asserted; SCR-07 400 code-format shows no tries left; the Inbox test really chooses twice.

tasks.title: Bring the auth and signed-in pages in line with screens.md and the accessibility rules
tasks.dod: Vitest: auth layout shows the logo asset; the resent alert has the info-circle icon; SCR-07 has a visible 'Sign-in code' label; SCR-10 matches screens.md (no extra heading, or screens.md updated); invalid inputs get aria-invalid + aria-describedby and errors sit in a live region; ConfirmDialog focuses its first button, traps focus and returns it on close. PageFrame icon buttons are ≥44 px on phone (CSS, checked in e2e).

tasks.title: Make the e2e run reliable: app healthcheck, pinned and type-checked e2e, strict AC-82 assertion, removed-passkey e2e
tasks.dod: compose `app` has a healthcheck so `docker compose up --wait` waits for it; e2e deps pinned to caret ranges and `tsc --noEmit` over e2e runs in the build/CI; the AC-82 e2e asserts exactly 'This link was already used'; an e2e removes a passkey, signs out and sees passkey sign-in refused with email sign-in still offered.
